verdict_vs_market.quote: The final offer is also strong relative to current reported Google L6 PM compensation: recent self-reported data places median L6 PM compensation around $514,000

verdict_vs_current.quote: Financially, the package now offers a legitimate switching premium: 1. Same base 2. Higher target bonus 3. 28% more annualized initial equity than your current $250,000 run rate 4. 15.6% higher annualized total compensation

recommendation.quote: Assuming the Google role, manager and scope are at least comparable to Meta, I would accept.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: recent self-reported data places median L6 PM compensation around $514,000, although those figures mix existing employees and new offers.

caveat_tenure_offering_company.quote: recent self-reported data places median L6 PM compensation around $514,000, although those figures mix existing employees and new offers.

caveat_tenure_current_employer.quote: Also recognize that maintaining Meta’s current $250,000 annual equity run rate likely depends partly on Meta refreshers, so neither long-term run rate is completely guaranteed

refresh_valued_at.quote: Treat future refreshers as upside, not guaranteed compensation

steady_state_math.quote: create a substantial year-four cliff. Google’s annual compensation process includes equity refresh determinations based on factors such as performance, location and role

level_claim.quote: A roughly 16% increase at the same nominal level is large enough to take seriously.

final_decision.quote: take it if you like the role and team reasonably well

ask_focus.quote: I would not push compensation again after they explicitly said this is final.

rsu_annualized.quote: If the $1.28 million grant vested evenly, that would be approximately $320,000 of Google equity in year one, versus $200,000 of Meta equity.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: The revised offer has crossed from “not enough to leave a job you like” to financially compelling. I would not walk away solely because there is no sign-on bonus.

forfeiture_netted.quote: You would give up approximately $200,000 of Meta RSUs during the next 12 months, but you would receive Google RSUs during that period.
